EIP-1559's burn mechanism stays intact, but Buterin treats it as incidental, stating fee burn below 10% of breakeven is acceptable long-term since ETH's value comes from elsewhere. The SoV case rests on Ethereum's CROPS properties, which produce protocol-level stability, the attribute users placing assets in the network value most. articles.headline: Your payment processor has a payment processor

None explicitly names the processor or acquiring bank, so a decision made several layers up can freeze a merchant who has no direct relationship with the decision-maker. Terms allow holds of 180 days or longer, Whop reserves up to 100% for up to 180 days, and Commas calls some risk decisions final. Other sellers' fraud or disputes can also tighten rules for everyone on the platform. Although the MoR model works and saves real compliance work, the label covers different arrangements, so merchants should ask who processes payments, how risk is assessed, what the reserve terms are, who can release funds, and plan for a long hold.
